data.title: About Kenneth
bio: Kenneth Rotondella, a longtime resident of Monmouth County, is a hardworking laborer in the international heavy and general laborers union since 2012.  He’s been a contractor for years and even spent a year working overseas, mining gold and diamonds.  Kenneth studied data communications, networking and graphic design at Rutgers, Penn State and Chubb institute and is truly a jack of all trades!

When he’s not diligently improving his knowledge, he enjoys spending time with his family and fishing!  Kenneth looks forward putting his extremely well managed time into tirelessly serving his real estate community.  Call him today at 732.
